name: Salamandre 1
description: Sapeur incendiaire creusant des tunnels enflammés sous les fortifications ennemies pour les faire s'effondrer.

subject.archetype: Salamandre 1 — Héritiers des cendres Common class spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Armor forged from melted debris and volcanic slag, dark metal plates held by thermal bonds glowing orange at every seam, heat distortion rising from every surface, scorch marks and soot coating every inch
loadout.arsenal: Dual flame projector gauntlets superheated to molten temperatures dripping liquid fire, volcanic glass blade still glowing cherry red at core, ash grenades on belt radiating heat The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting opposite_side, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Both hands thrust forward in powerful push with focused targeted dimensional pressure field expanding from palms creating visible wall of force pushing against entire opposing side
attitude.emotion: Focused determination — seasoned professional locked in the moment of combat

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Ember Orange
palette_names.role: primary_accent — flames, energy blasts and burning particles

palette_names.name: Magma Yellow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — lava flows and inner core glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: brushed steel utility frame, simple geometric corner markers, no ornamentation, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Eye-level medium shot capturing face and primary action clearly, shallow depth of field, motion freeze at peak of action

scenography.setting: Volcanic battlefield mid-eruption with lava rivers bursting through cracked ground flowing around combat zone, character standing in center of massive firestorm, burning debris raining from ash-choked sky, enemy positions engulfed in flames with structures collapsing into molten ground
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Massive force visible through environmental disruption — air rippling like heat haze, ground buckling and cracking, everything on opposite side being physically pushed backward and compressed, Opposing terrain visibly compressed and pushed backward, barriers and structures cracking from extreme pressure, objects sliding away creating clear zone of force, Massive fireball erupting from character engulfing foreground with intense orange light, lava cracking through ground with molten splashes flying up in slow motion, embers and ash swirling in thermal vortex, visible heat distortion waves rippling the air, secondary explosions in background sending shockwaves through smoke
